policies.policyname: Users can view allowed entry group slides
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (entry_groups g
     JOIN wine_entries e ON ((e.id = COALESCE(entry_group_slides.entry_id, g.anchor_entry_id))))
  WHERE ((g.id = entry_group_slides.group_id) AND (e.entry_group_id = g.id) AND (e.user_id = g.user_id) AND can_view_entry(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), e.user_id, e.entry_privacy) AND can_view_entry(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), e.user_id,
        CASE entry_group_slides.photo_type
            WHEN 'label'::text THEN COALESCE(e.label_photo_privacy, e.entry_privacy)
            WHEN 'place'::text THEN COALESCE(e.place_photo_privacy, e.entry_privacy)
            ELSE e.entry_privacy
        END) AND ((entry_group_slides.entry_id IS NOT NULL) OR (split_part(entry_group_slides.path, '/'::text, 1) = (g.user_id)::text)))))

policies.policyname: Users can view allowed entry groups
policies.qual:

  WHERE ((e.id = entry_groups.anchor_entry_id) AND (e.entry_group_id = entry_groups.id) AND (e.user_id = entry_groups.user_id) AND can_view_entry(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), e.user_id, e.entry_privacy))))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_access_wine_photo(object_name text)

 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
